note: VCA vs ordered baseline, both materials, same route (phono3py RTA, 20^3, 300 K, largest FC3 cutoff, isotopes on in the baseline). kappa_zz_rest is the rest-of-the-zone term; kappa_zz_total is the raw total and carries the Gamma-Z quadrature artifact.
construction: VCA: site masses averaged over the antisite occupancy, disorder returned as mass-variance (Tamura) scattering. Averaged mass and g per site follow analysis/extrinsic/kappa_extrinsic.py with each material's x: MnIn2Se4 x=0.44 (Doll i=0.44), Mn2In2Se5 x=0.19 (Williams 2024, ESI Table S7; since 2026-11-21). The earlier x=0.13 (kappa fit) run is kept as Mn2In2Se5_x013_archive.
